name: Set up a documentation system and write procedures that pass
why: A full documentation system with procedures and a check of each, matching the SOP writing skill and the library plan.

name: Process doc freshness keeper
why: Finds stale or ownerless SOPs each month, which keeps the review dates in the SOP skill honest.

name: Process waste finder
why: Marks each step as value or waste, a quick first pass before the full process map.

name: Trace why work keeps missing deadlines
why: A delay map and causes backed by records, like the bottleneck skill's diagnosis steps.

name: Make a recurring process easier to hand over
why: Builds a procedure, exception guide and handover note from a real run, like the hand-over prompt.

name: Hand over founder dependent operations
why: Finds work only the founder does and plans who takes it, the next step after the owner time audit.

name: Operations manual writer
why: Turns a standards sheet into job cards and a day-one trial sheet for the operations manual skill.

name: Shop operations and expansion planner
why: Written standards, a manual a stranger can follow and a go or no-go check before opening another site.

name: Define your metrics once and write a weekly update
why: Fixes metric definitions and the weekly update format that the weekly ops review depends on.

name: Process change note writer
why: Tells the team what changes and from when after a trial is kept and the SOP is updated.

name: Process and meeting cull planner
why: A keep, simplify or drop call on regular meetings, approvals and reports, useful before redesigning the weekly rhythm.

name: Weekly time audit planner
why: Counts where last week's hours went, a lighter version of the owner time audit.
